# Coldop

> Coldop is a cold storage management and inventory software for Indian
> operators — gate passes, chamber-wise stock, farmer ledgers, daybook, and
> PDF/Excel reports in one system. Built in Punjab for the warehouse floor,
> with a bilingual English–Punjabi interface. Estd. 2023.

## What Coldop does
- Gate pass management: incoming and outgoing passes created at the gate
- Chamber stock: live inventory by chamber, floor, and row
- Farmer ledgers: per-farmer balances, gate-pass history, printable ledgers
- Stock transfers between farmer accounts without rewriting books
- Occupancy analytics: capacity utilization, variety and size mix, top farmers
- Reports: vouchers, ledgers, Incoming/Outgoing/Transfer in PDF and Excel
- No hardware required; works on any phone, tablet, or desktop

## Who uses it
50+ chambers digitized across Punjab cold storages, including Raghav Cold
Storage (Brahmpur), Satnam Cold Storage (Madhojhanda), Kartarpur Cold Storage
(Kartarpur), and Bolina Farms (Karari). 10 lakh+ potato bags managed and
5,000+ receipts created (as of July 2026).
